label: Sleep & rest
description: Whether a person can sleep and rest for adequate, uninterrupted periods, in tolerable light, noise, temperature, and company.

label: Hygiene & bodily privacy
description: Whether a person can use a toilet, wash, shower, and manage menstruation and other bodily needs promptly, cleanly, and without being watched.

label: Food & water
description: Whether a person can get adequate, safe food and drinking water at predictable times, and eat somewhere separate from sleeping and sanitation.

label: Sensory regulation
phrase: a person's ability to regulate sensory load
description: Whether a person can find relief from noise, light, odor, crowding, and monotony, and recover from sensory overload.

label: Movement & recreation
description: Whether a person can walk, exercise, go outdoors, and spend part of the day in activity rather than confinement.

label: Medical access
description: Whether a person can get timely medical, dental, and mental-health care, and be protected from illness spreading through the population.

label: Legal & social communication
description: Whether a person can reach lawyers, courts, family, and others reliably and privately, by phone, video, or in person.

label: Temporal orientation
phrase: a person's ability to orient themselves in time
description: Whether a person can keep track of the time of day, the days, the weather, and the seasons.

label: Safety & conflict exposure
description: Whether a person is protected from violence, theft, and physical hazards, and can avoid or move away from conflict.

label: Agency & dignity
description: Whether a person can make everyday choices, keep belongings and a place of their own, and keep some privacy and control over their day.
